name: design-taste-frontend (tasteskill)
what: Skill that builds marketing and company websites with dealt hero layouts, palettes and font pairings, licensed stand-in photographs and a browser gate that must pass before the work stops. Web pages only. It declares a Stop hook.
install: npx skills@1.8.1 add Leonxlnx/taste-skill@f6b76575f949707b4e3c37cd86cb44b0b98643e8 --skill design-taste-frontend. Offer it and wait for the user's yes: it declares a Stop hook.
firstCall: scripts/gate.mjs with --start, --kind, --category and --primary (arm the gate before any page exists)
evidenceNote: Read from a shallow clone of the public repository: the skill file, the changelog and the photo reference. Not installed. No script and no gate run. Companion skills by the same author were not read.
